description: Estimates monthly and yearly Instagram brand-deal income from the rates the user charges per post, per story or per 1,000 followers, and the cost per engagement a brand pays.

avg_engagements_per_post.description: Optional average likes plus comments plus saves plus shares per post.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

posts_per_month.description: Sponsored posts or reels per month.

rate_per_1000_followers.description: Fee per post per 1,000 followers, in currency units.

rate_per_post.description: Fee per sponsored post, in currency units. Use this or rate_per_1000_followers.
